item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find credible 2024 evidence that Hasina consciously reduced domestic fear while avoiding state terror or a wider political fear climate. I also did not find reliable evidence of a sustained, non-coercive public-safety strategy that materially lowered fear among opponents, journalists, or protesters. The closest positive material is defensive border/Rohingya management, which is not strong evidence for this lens.","evidence":[{"title":"Bangladesh blocks roads and internet, deploys army to curb protests","publisher":"Reuters","date":"July 20, 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/world/bangladesh-blocks-roads-and-internet-deploys-army-to-curb-protests/2183179/","summary":"Soldiers patrolled Dhaka, roadblocks went up, and internet/text services were suspended during the protest crackdown; this is strong evidence of fear-producing coercive control rather than fear reduction.","question_ids":["3B.6","3B.5","3B.1","2B.4"]},{"title":"Bangladesh PM Hasina blames opposition for violence, curfew to remain","publisher":"Reuters","date":"July 22, 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/bangladesh-pm-hasina-blames-opposition-for-violence-curfew-to-remain-3528153","summary":"Hasina blamed political opponents for the violence and kept the curfew in place, which reads as political fear management through scapegoating and coercion rather than restoring public security.","question_ids":["3B.6","3B.3","3B.5","2B.6","2B.7"]},{"title":"Bangladesh’s internet shutdown isolates citizens, disrupts business","publisher":"Reuters","date":"July 26, 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/bangladeshs-internet-shutdown-isolates-citizens-disrupts-business-3539448","summary":"Reuters said the government imposed a comprehensive internet outage and countrywide curfew, a tactic it had used previously at refugee camps and ahead of elections; that supports a broader climate of intimidation and information control.","question_ids":["3B.6","3B.5","3B.1"]},{"title":"Bangladesh restores internet as students call off job-quota protests","publisher":"Reuters","date":"July 29, 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/bangladesh-restores-internet-as-students-call-off-jobquota-protests-3540555","summary":"Internet service was restored only after protests were called off and conditions were said to be returning to normal; this is the closest weak counterevidence, but it reflects de-escalation after coercive disruption, not a proactive fear-reduction strategy.","question_ids":["3B.6","3B.5"]},{"title":"Exclusive-Bangladesh army refused to suppress protest, sealing Hasina's fate","publisher":"Reuters","date":"August 7, 2024","url":"https://www.voanews.com/a/exclusive-bangladesh-army-refused-to-suppress-protest-sealing-hasina-s-fate/7733166.html","summary":"The army refused to open fire on civilians to enforce Hasina’s curfew, implying the coercive apparatus had been pushed toward lethal domestic enforcement; that is incompatible with a low-fear, rights-respecting security posture.","question_ids":["3B.6","3B.1","3B.2","2B.4","2B.9"]},{"title":"Bangladesh will not let in any more Rohingya refugees - minister","publisher":"Reuters","date":"February 7, 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/world/bangladesh-will-not-let-in-any-more-rohingya-refugees-minister/1958020/","summary":"Bangladesh framed refusal to admit additional Rohingya as a security necessity; this is the strongest limited positive item, but it is indirect, voiced by a minister, and concerns border management rather than reducing domestic fear.","question_ids":["3B.6","2B.3"]},{"title":"Bangladesh ramps up border vigilance as thousands of Rohingya flee Myanmar","publisher":"Reuters","date":"September 11, 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/world/bangladesh-ramps-up-border-vigilance-as-thousands-of-rohingya-flee-myanmar/2262488/","summary":"Bangladesh tightened border vigilance amid violence in Myanmar and refugee flows; this is a defensive security move, but it does not show reduction of domestic fear or avoidance of a broader political fear climate.","question_ids":["3B.6","2B.3"]},{"title":"Bangladesh: Freedom on the Net 2024 Country Report","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2024","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/bangladesh/freedom-net/2024","summary":"Freedom House reports partial restrictions on internet and communications during protests, elections, and tense moments, including the July 2024 shutdown; this directly supports the conclusion that the government used control tools that amplified fear and constrained information.","question_ids":["3B.6","3B.5","3B.1"]}]}
